name: Hotel Jade CIQ
detail: An ideal accommodation choice for travelers needing quick access to JB Sentral and CIQ. The 4-bed dormitory-style room was orderly and comfortable. The inclusion of a Coway water machine and a self-service coffee and tea beverage station was an impressive touch that greatly enhanced the experience. Outstanding value for money.
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: KSL Hotel & Resort
detail: The hotel facilities are first-class, especially the pool which is clean and comfortable. The bathroom amenities are complete, and the hot water supply is stable. The quality of service is outstanding, with friendly and attentive staff. The breakfast variety is rich and delicious, leaving a lasting impression. I slept well, and the bed is comfortable. Overall, it was a pleasant stay experience.
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: Sunday- Johor Bahru Near Mid Valley Southkey Formally Lace Boutique
detail: The room is very beautiful, spacious, convenient, and clean. The staff are friendly and lovely. Most importantly, it's amazing that for this price, I received such a luxurious and expensive-looking room. I will definitely come again.
area: Stulang Bahru,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: Hotel Granada Johor Bahru
detail: Penginapan yang sangat memuaskan. Lokasi hotel memang tersangat strategik—berdekatan dengan Aeon Mall Bukit Indah (jalan kaki sekitar 8 minit sahaja) dan paling best, restoran McDonald's terletak betul-betul di sebelah hotel. Sangat memudahkan kalau lapar tengah malam. Rasa-rasanya taraf hotel ini sekitar 3 ke 4 bintang. Walaupun hiasan dalaman bilik nampak sedikit oldschool atau klasik, tetapi ia dijaga dengan sangat bersih, kemas, dan selesa. Menu sarapan pagi (breakfast) juga okay dan ada banyak variasi pilihan hidangan. Nota untuk tetamu lain: Masa proses check-in, pihak hotel ada meminta deposit sebanyak RM100 (boleh rujuk resit/bukti dalam gambar yang saya sertakan). Secara keseluruhan, ia sebuah hotel yang sangat praktikal, bersih, dan berbaloi untuk sesiapa yang datang ke kawasan Bukit Indah.
area: Bukit Indah,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: Grand Jade CIQ Hotel
detail: The hygiene conditions are quite good. There are public areas and a terrace. The front desk staff do not speak Chinese, but the service staff are very friendly. It is also very quiet at night with no noise. I recommend the four-person female dorm; I only stayed in a three-person room. The location is great, with shopping malls and Chen Xunian Cultural Street within walking distance. Overall, it was quite comfortable to stay there.
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: Citrus Hotel Johor Bahru by Compass Hospitality
detail: Thank you for allowing an early check-in. I appreciate you accommodating my room request. I was particularly impressed by the hardworking attitude of the young male and female staff at the front desk. Although the hairdryer in the room was broken, they promptly brought a portable hairdryer. The breakfast was delicious with a sufficient variety of items and the staff were very friendly. I will definitely stay here again next time. It’s about a 15-minute walk from the immigration office.
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: Attrus Bed & Breakfast . 聚
detail: I arrived feeling exhausted, but checking into Attrus Bed & Breakfast Johor Bahru truly made my day. Honestly, this is one of the best hostels I’ve ever stayed at during my travels across several countries. Imagine this — they offer queen-sized bunk beds that are super comfortable, and the room ambiance is cozy and modern. As soon as you walk into the lobby, you’ll be greeted by a super friendly receptionist (I wish I remembered her name!) — she was so warm and welcoming, it really set the tone for my stay. What makes it even better is the kopitiam-style restaurant downstairs called Padi, where guests enjoy a 10% discount. Please, do yourself a favor and try their signature fried banana (pisang goreng) — I was seriously addicted! The food overall is tasty and satisfying. If you’re driving, the parking is spacious and convenient, with a lift that brings you directly to the lobby and rooms. I ended up extending my stay because everything was just so comfortable, and the location is super close to a mall. Huge thanks to the lovely staff (all of them are so kind and pretty!) — I’ll definitely return and recommend Attrus Bed & Breakfast JB to all my friends. Love you all!
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: My Capsule Hotel - Self check-in, whatsapp only
detail: The check-in process is very easy. From point [•A•] ➺ [•Z•] it is quite satisfactory. The check-in instructions are very complete. From the information on the main door password to obtaining access cards are also well stated. The air conditioning is quite cold (it feels very cold for sleeping at night (for me)). Even though I wore a jacket + track pants + blanket, it still felt very cold. I hope there is a remote control that can adjust the room temperature appropriately. Above 20° is more comfortable and suitable (for a small room, 16°c feels very cold even while sitting in a capsule that is not activated in fan mode/feature. I feel the temperature (°) at that time was no more than 16°c, according to the temperature I felt at that time. The toilet is also quite clean and spacious. Everything is complete in one toilet. There is a sink + mirror and shower (hot shower) included. Everything is complete. The hotel area is also clean (it could just be improved in the main area during the new guest 'lobby'). If possible, make a space for prayer (for Muslim visitors). Alright, that’s all the 'review' or feedback related to my first experience staying at this 'capsule' themed hotel. Thank you to the owners of this 'property', staff, housekeeping, and anyone related either directly or indirectly. Special appreciation is also given to #AGODA™ itself for their hotel booking service and the offers provided. This is certainly a very good new experience. I will definitely choose this capsule hotel again in the future when I want to explore the JB area, especially in 📍Taman Molek~. Respectful greetings~

name: Havona Signature @ Meldrum CIQ
detail: This hotel should be newly opened or renovated; there are machines for self-check-in at the entrance, and staff are available to assist. A deposit of 50 ringgit in cash is required, but if you don't have it, you can exchange other currencies with the staff. The room facilities are fairly good for this price range. There's indeed a construction site across from the window, but it felt fine at night; it might be a bit noisy during the day. However, hotel prices near Johor Bahru train station increase significantly during weekends, and this one is relatively cost-effective. It's about a 10-minute walk to the train station via a pedestrian bridge.
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map

name: T-hotel JB
detail: 1. Location: It is close to the night market, old town, and Indian street, and there are many restaurants open late at night, as well as massage shops, large malls, convenience stores, etc. The location is excellent as it has everything you need. Above all, being close to the border office is a big advantage. It is located within a 10-minute walk. 2. Price: It is cheaper compared to nearby accommodations. When I searched, it was the least expensive. 3. Hygiene and Service: I think it's understandable considering the price. Although there is no complimentary water service, basic shower gel, shampoo, and towels are provided, and the air conditioning and ceiling fan work well to keep it cool. 4. Kindness: I appreciate the friendliness of the Bangladeshi staff at the check-in counter. I also thank them for operating the check-in counter 24 hours. Overall, I am satisfied~^^
area: Johor Bahru City Center,Johor Bahru - View on map
